rule.unavailable: plant_date or harvest_date null, or date outside published_range; never clamped; all numbers null
rule.days_from_planting: date - plant_date, signed whole calendar days (no time of day; use Date.UTC)
rule.days_from_harvest: date - harvest_date, signed whole calendar days
rule.progress: (100 * days_from_planting) / (harvest_date - plant_date) in the active phase, multiply then divide, unrounded; null otherwise
rule.series_id: a decimal string: the integer exceeds 2^53 and must not be parsed as a JavaScript number
rule.independence: the status of a row at a date does not depend on the map that requests it
